name: FindAndReplaceInDataTable
label: Find or Replace in Data Table
description: Finds and/or replaces data table values.

fields.name: SearchMode
fields.label: Search Mode
fields.description: Specifies whether to find or find and replace values.

selectOptions.label: Find
selectOptions.description: Locates values in the data table.

selectOptions.label: Find and Replace
selectOptions.description: Locates and replaces values in the data table.

fields.name: TextToFind
fields.label: Text to Find
fields.description: The value to find in the data table.

fields.name: TextToReplaceWith
fields.label: Text to Replace With
fields.description: The value to replace with (required if 'Search Mode' is 'Find and Replace').

fields.name: AllMatches
fields.label: All Matches
fields.description: If true, processes all occurrences. If false, processes only the first occurrence.

fields.name: UseRegularExpression
fields.label: Find Using a Regular Expression
fields.description: If true, uses regular expressions for matching.

fields.name: MatchCase
fields.label: Match Case
fields.description: If true, performs a case-sensitive search.

fields.name: MatchEntireCellContents
fields.label: Match Entire Cell Contents
fields.description: If true, matches only cells that contain exactly the specified text.

fields.name: SearchBy
fields.label: Search By
fields.description: Specifies how to search the data table.

selectOptions.label: Everywhere
selectOptions.description: Searches all columns in the data table.

selectOptions.label: On Column
selectOptions.description: Searches a specific column in the data table.

fields.name: ColumnIndexOrName
fields.label: Column Index or Name
fields.description: The column index or name to search within (required if 'Search By' is 'On Column').

fields.name: MatchedRows
fields.label: Matched Rows
fields.description: Returns the rows that match the search criteria.
